verdicts.reason: Both break the stacked three-box title: "KIT" is separated from its white box, which is left empty at the bottom right, and the background shows a visible lighter centre panel with hard seams. A at least sets "KIT" on plain slate, with larger, more readable "TRAVEL"/"MAKEUP", but those boxes sit cramped against the top and bottom edges. In B the "TRAVEL"/"MAKEUP" text is small and weak, and "KIT" sits across the seam over the busy blue powder, so it collides with the image and reads worse.
